Unknown exact site throws before owner or receipt mutation

Stale sampling intent leaves exact owner snapshot unchanged

Receipt records actual before/after damage and the current attempt
Accepted sampling projects actual wait contact, not a fabricated skill
Actual encounter sampling never advances historical workshop time
One spent case cannot collect the same site again
Survey victory carries sample but cannot secure final route
Earned allocation cannot resupply or secure cargo
Later site cannot replace the already carried sample

Final security preserves original acquisition receipt
Deferring site keeps the same unused case after survey
Actual second encounter position two opens channel only
Channel sampling pays actual stationary pulse
Channel route can actually secure the exclusive later sample
Low actual HP ridge eligibility does not promise survival
Lethal collection wait spends case without acquiring
Retry cannot replace case broken before acquisition

Ordinary failure does not consume an unused case
Same originally unused case remains usable on real retry
Skipping sampling preserves actual old full-route outcomes
Living deadline failure spends case without false acquisition caption
Repeated reads retain cargo receipt and event identity
